notes.title: FRIGID - NEWS UPDATE - NEW COOP TEASER
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/bf337b6539cef5dff1ed852ce01ba204c098be90.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEWS UPDATE 2024[/h1]
Hi, Welcome back survivors, we have been hard at work solving problems which we talked about in the Frigid Update Discussion Topic posted at the beginning of the year.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/905540/discussions/0/4138312860558313742/

We are still not quite finished yet, and more work is currently being focused on, but the new schedule is looking good and focus on marketing frigid may come sooner then expected. 

Currently we are working on streamlining project releases and Frigid release date will be revealed on the store page when we are ready to realistically commit to an official deadline. 

Now onto the new news to wrap up the Steam Survival Fest... Enjoy!

[h2]NEW 4K VIDEO - FRIGID COOP TEASER[/h2]
[previewyoutube=KrxddC86MPk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]FRIGID IS NOW ON UNREAL ENGINE 5 [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/44ed97f71b6a210de502935ab9e1420b9923e2e2.jpg[/img]
With frigid being upgraded to the latest engine, we have solved the majority of technical problems, added multiplayer support, and will be utilizing the latest in unreal technology including lumen, nanite and chaos destruction and next generation optimization. 

[h2]FRIGID MULTIPLAYER COOP STORY CAMPAIGN[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/f77b8c18d78acafe78bcbe07e1779a3cf691fb57.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/96788d6941c9a6d6086d86401c0722ed129de34c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/ccbe68592a037a6ff93b8eff1dc8c9ec21559035.jpg[/img]
This new multiplayer coop support allows 2 players to play the single player story campaign. You will be able to play frigid with your best friend.

[h2]FRIGID MULTIPLAYER COOP SURVIVAL MODE[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/a08870b4fbc09e05bf4055d4a62976f73caa58a1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/d3743191710c407e20fac37d082cb65b36090869.jpg[/img]
Additionally, we are offering a complete separate survival mode in multiplayer to team up and take on custom made maps based on pure survival without a story. Endless days of survival with your friends! This mode will be focused on brutal survival. We are going to make it hard and force players to rely on each other to survive.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/210568450d03f546fe9766f341a3a765c618a135.jpg[/img]
[h2]SUPPORT US BY BUYING A COFFEE SO WE CAN KEEP GRINDING![/h2]
[h3][url=https://www.patreon.com/frigidgame]FRIGID GAME PATREON[/url][/h3]

[h3]DON'T FORGET TO FOLLOW PAGE FOR UPDATES + WISH-LIST NOW![/h3]

NEW 4K VIDEO - Live or die on this day.
[previewyoutube=3UnKAEBGesU;full][/previewyoutube]
Amber, the chief climate science researcher instructed you to make your way up north into the mountains, she warned you that these 'things' you will encounter can assimilate into any organism. Having said that, they are only beginning to spread, and few and far in between, your immediate danger, is to get through each day, day by day, alive! It's not going to be hard, but brutal, as nature intended for it to be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/2285e0d355434fe9fd6f6151aba0ee8028b0e35e.jpg[/img]
Your tent and minimal gear may not provide the best shelter, but your resourcefulness will allow you to maintain mobility for the long trek up the mountains. Balance is always on your mind, should you build that log shelter and keep the beasts at bay? or risk it and move through areas quickly. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/eed8366db506549327ffad9327df05013ce621e6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/eab1dc53931ad984dfb00abefc0983edb4c8ad38.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/eba4641a5afa5da7d031d0d7a80eff961923325f.jpg[/img]
Here you see beautiful pictures of mankind cutting down nature in order to survive. Be careful, to cut down such a tree will exhaust your muscles and stamina for the rest of the day. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/ae05e4185ea95245814a2fb484f203ccc32aec9f.jpg[/img]
Live or Die is the rule of the day, not just for you, but all of natures creatures. Always keep that in mind!

notes.title: FRIGID - Pristine Lake Map Dev Update #2
notes.content:
Welcome back arctic survivors. We have completed the majority of the pristine lake map. Today, we share with you a few in-game snapshots and video clips of our work in progress.

[previewyoutube=645kGEIryec;full][/previewyoutube]

Don't forget to help make this game a reality by following our game on steam and adding it to your Steam WishList above and join our kick starter page here [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/celeritasgames/frigid]Click here to Follow[/url]

As promised, this map is an open world exploration experience. You can go where ever you like and accomplish tasks and objectives in whatever order you deem fit. The main obstacles will be figuring out navigation over a crippled ice sheet, shattered by ice drifts, causing breaks in the ice revealing ice cold river streams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/848ffc4d695531475ee5edb4327989eb2b69a067.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/bdb7ef8473754591bb6c0466f330b1eb50e1f938.jpg[/img]

Learn of what the Archeologist found on the ice by exploring many of the research tents setup in the area. Using your intelligence, you can figure out how to contain or defeat the spread of the infection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/7b452d8756dceab853eaad7d9b6819e528419c86.jpg[/img]

Fishing and hunting on the Ice will be critical to your survival.
When the night falls over the lake, the weather is extreme, you will need to stay in shelter over night or you will freeze fast. New items include building fishing shacks, using arctic navigation poles, climbing ice walls with an ice pick tool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/8b6531e312ee82aca821669297cfd3853276f253.jpg[/img]

Staying away from stage 2 infected polar bears who lurk all over the surface of the ice will be a challenge in itself. These creatures are brutal! More detailed information about them will be revealed soon. For now enjoy the tease below...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/68f1aa7b6d3832ce7cbd2dd4034ed0ff88990871.jpg[/img]

Thank you to all of you who follow and we will see you on the next developer update. Let us know what you think below, bye for now.

notes.title: FRIGID - Stage 2 Infection Reveal
notes.content:
Please take the time to follow our kick starter page here [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/celeritasgames/frigid]Kickstarter sign up[/url] This will help us a lot.

Welcome Survivors. Today, we introduce the Stage 2 infected Polar Bear.

FRIGID - Stage 2 Infection Ursidae (Bear)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/6fc356342ebe9bbdea69e85c1b5cfd894f0d5be1.jpg[/img]

As you may already know, climate change has melted the arctic glaciers by 75%. This has caused a cascade of events in the ecosystems nearby, resulting in a devastating outcome for the wildlife in the area.

These creatures tend to lurk around and in the pristine lake region.
Further study of the Stage 2 Infected Polar bear reveals remarkable changes to the animals anatomy.   
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/e2947c8cd4481886bb274f32d94186664e46867a.jpg[/img]

Stage 2 Infection consists of alien extremities coming out from under skin lesions all over the body. When the creature approaches its victim, these appendages rip out from the original host and attack their victims with extreme force.  

These changes in anatomy signify Stage 2 Infection. This make it extremely dangerous up close. The speed and muscle strength from these tentacles are overwhelming and can penetrate through the human body and clothing.  

Stay away from any infected animal as stage 2 cannot be detected, I cannot stress this enough, if they get close to you, death is certain. They do not appear to be aggressive until the last moment where they can get there tentacles in striking range and infect you. 

Locals have mentioned some odd sounds coming before an attack. BE VERY VIGILANT! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/eed12098d8f4776d3a2853c850abdb5a66800683.png[/img]

We all respect the wildlife, but in these hard times if you see one, the only sure way to contain these animals will be to shoot them from afar,  This is the only way to protect us and stop the spread of the infection.  A shot to the head works best or a few slugs in the belly should do the trick. Make sure to burn Stage 2 Infected corpses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/14c776fa705bdce3045a5219f25a52e0824fe220.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/f00bb565b6c293a7aab35b4011ee5d27b243ec9b.jpg[/img]
Please take the time to follow our kick starter page here [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/celeritasgames/frigid]Kickstarter sign up[/url]

Do not forget to add FRIGID to Steam Wish List by clicking the link in the sidebar. 
Thank you, see you soon.

notes.title: FRIGID BETA TEST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/bd999c166307c6c3b71632c15c10970967cfe809.jpg[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/905540/FRIGID/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/ec485b3bc779ecdef9a12dda1419dd52000eaa1d.jpg[/img][/url]

We have updated the demo with another level and extended the play through with more game play and features so you can get a deeper Frigid experience in this Beta.

In the extended beta demo, we will be showcasing some more of the game features previously unseen and reveal some pieces of the story and much more!

This way you will have a better idea of our vision for the game. Hopefully, this will give you an idea of what we would like to create and give you the confidence to support us in our upcoming Kick starter.

Please give feedback at our discord so we can make the best game possible.

The first big feature is the Time of Day game play, If you stay in one area or take things slow, you will see the sun move and the environment change, this will make the game more challenging at night.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/27784dee7fbecf9e2883826ef43e68ce93a6f67f.jpg[/img]

We have added a new tool, the flare gun, this will come in handy against wild animals and light up your view at night.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/d4d9d9b7d6677e36e12d5ea667397ed3d61b88f9.jpg[/img]

We have added wolves into the demo so you will need to deal with them as you see fit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/4bb0fa81b382e4eb3550ba3de7e6e39725f0ed75.jpg[/img]

We added more notes in the game, this gives a little more insight to the story of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/c188ab3ac979a05ec0e7e9e5befd34ad739fc9d4.jpg[/img]

The sleeping bag now allows you to rest and pass time or wait for different lighting scenarios.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/f48eda8bdd7e39177c878dfda609d4fc91e4cd21.jpg[/img]

The shovel is a new item in the game, you will need to craft this item so you can clear snow piles blocking certain areas.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/1422afa6cb16983e707126237955d208baeb1193.jpg[/img]

We have added weapons to the game, a pistol and rifle. Be careful ammo is scarce.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/6c2bf9f24b51162db4e1f940f2649ccbddfd1dfe.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/d76ed57b807bb1033c03e826d82bf1cf642394e6.jpg[/img]

We have lots of crafting in the game now. Craft items to progress in the beta, find supplies in the environment to craft special items and tools.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/da23fcade1860bb21e21de106bcc37231f2b1114.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/f28bb35ca433538ae65ebbe77deab7fe213928e0.jpg[/img]

And finally the new building mechanic, you can create a shelter from the resources you scavenge in the area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/efcb596cd7bad08b90f8c2b548008e4712cf46a5.jpg[/img]

We have many more improvements in optimization and bug fixes that are to long to mention here.

We need your help, please follow our game on steam and add to wish list. Share our game and leave comments. Thank you for taking the time to check out our game.

Hope you can enjoy this beta by signing up.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/mM4WpDr]Discord[/url]

notes.title: FRIGID - Stage 1 Infection Vulpes vulpes
notes.content:
Welcome survivors. Today, we introduce our next infected creature in Frigid.
The Vulpes (Fox) Stage 1 Infection.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/7417e85462f4f2bcf5c0d12762460e81993dc955.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=ZgQ-SxG3Ld4;full][/previewyoutube]

We are receiving multiple reports just in. Packs of Infected Foxes are scavenging around the lake area. They are extremely fast and intelligent, working together to quickly overwhelm their prey with speed. If you hear them in the distance, it may already be to late, unless you can get to nearby shelter. 

Local Hunters are warning you not to engage with firearms. It is nearly impossible to hit these creatures with their current mobility and speed. If you can spot them in the distance with a sniper you have the advantage, or simply use gas and fire as they come running for you, it may be your last chance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/f1b64712c47cef8027bc202600d2a42c342669a3.jpg[/img]
The usual symptoms of the infection are present, although the foxes, smaller in size compared to the other animals have greatly increased their short term cardiovascular carbon dioxide expulsion allowing for incredible speed bursts.  Please stay inside, until the park rangers can figure out a way to deal with these foxes reliably.

Add FRIGID to Steam Wishlist by clicking the link in the sidebar and Follow in the Community section for more updates incoming, Thank you.

notes.title: FRIGID - Stage 1 Infection Ursidae
notes.content:
Welcome survivors. Today, we introduce our next infected creature in Frigid.
The Ursidae (Bear) Stage 1 Infection.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/56fd25271f3e73ab4ae6ee84cb28d6f62c4ba7b5.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=JHfq0bF2eJA;full][previewyoutube=8dnvpPyaNwE;full][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

Local residents are reporting an unusual amount of infected bears in the area. These animals are now scavenging on local property, creating a potentially dangerous situation. The local hunter's have taken it upon themselves to control the situation and are currently hunting them down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/96f5014d0bc4c5e3c2a284592e8f3519f9847751.jpg[/img]

What is even more concerning, is that these infected bears are producing extreme lacerations coming from the infected lesions on their skin. They seem to be ripping apart, at the muscle level, this is scientifically impossible! We need more time to determine the severity of the infection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/b1be8f8700289d723089dd30e730a31c725452ce.jpg[/img]
Furthermore, locals tell us clues of how the animals vocal sounds may have been affected. They report the sounds the bears make are practically unbearable.  Keep your distance or the sound will effect your mental sanity causing you to temporarily fall unconscious.

Please add FRIGID to Steam Wishlist by clicking the link in the sidebar. Thank you, see you soon.

notes.title: FRIGID - Stage 1 Infection Cervidae
notes.content:
Welcome survivors. Today, we introduce our next infected creature in Frigid.
The Cervidae (Deer) Stage 1 Infection.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/8777f1118305afccd295ab6fc6dea7a11896ec60.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=8dnvpPyaNwE;full][/previewyoutube]

The Deer of Pristine Lake have been spotted with Stage 1 infection. The situation is escalating. These animals are shedding their skin membrane and revealing internal rib cage and other skeletal bones. Its only a matter of time before they either decay or turn into Stage 2 infection. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/862f6354928891276a5bb8d9732ab89b64aa60b5.jpg[/img]

What is remarkable of this change in physiology is only matched by there newly acquired galloping speed. These deer's can close a distance faster then the wolves previously mentioned. They look erie and unnatural as they come charging for you. Thankfully our Marksmen has kept us safe so far.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/d929db22e40ac178c2e0a97cf78a67c7cc0d819d.jpg[/img]
It appears something is growing from the animals antlers. Further details once the autopsy is completed.

Please add FRIGID to Steam Wish list by clicking the link in the sidebar. Thank you, see you soon.

notes.title: FRIGID - Stage 1 Infection Canis lupus
notes.content:
FRIGID - Stage 1 Infection Cervidae

Welcome survivors. Today, we introduce our next infected creature in Frigid.

The Infection Cervidae (Deer) Stage 1 Infection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/0ecb7eb0626ab84333243ea116ab74bb07f7937a.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=WJ7AZxP5jN8;full]Youtube link[/previewyoutube]

As you may already know, climate change has melted the arctic glaciers by 75%. This has caused a cascade of events in the environment ecosystems nearby, resulting in a devastating outcome for the wildlife in the area.

Our research proves a direct causation of infection originating from pristine lake area. The results are conclusive. We must understand the depth of infection by capturing these animals in higher stage infections for further study.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/0de25eece37809ac1e1b56e0792fa7c7395dd00f.jpg[/img]

Quarantine procedures are currently being implemented all over the surrounding areas in a crucial attempt to contain the situation. Evacuations are in progress. No known human transmission recorded thus far.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/0ecb7eb0626ab84333243ea116ab74bb07f7937a.jpg[/img]

Stage 1 Infection consists of growing lesions all over the body removing patches of fur in the process. It does not appear to spread via direct contact. The animal characteristics are hyperbolic with an increased speed and muscle strength. The eyes blister red and fade to white or grey. They do not appear to be more aggressive making it difficult to spot them. Be careful.

Do not forget to add FRIGID to Steam WishList by clicking the link in the sidebar. Thank you, see you soon.

notes.title: Frigid Dev Update #1
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=iAzq8uMwhu8;full][/previewyoutube]

Today we bring you new wildlife in the frigid demo. This includes Squirrels, Rabbits, and Eagles.

RABBITS / SQUIRRELS

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/f836e0a8a7f194979422f17dbb4b842339c96ec6.jpg[/img]

We have added rabbits and squirrels into the game to bring more atmosphere and realism to the environment.

In the video, you can see cute little rabbits and squirrels running around. They move around the environment looking for food. If they spot the player they will flee. They are incredibly hard to capture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/5f7de4015e85dc26dcb8a81cf98f1f07bbaf291a.jpg[/img]

If you are able to kill one, you can harvest the meat for some extra protein. If you can afford some patients you can observe their behavior patterns and take advantage of this to successfully kill the animals for food or resources provided you have a tool or weapon to do so.


EAGLES

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/2d24c01c68429bfdff84c59d3e9eaf4dfd94e563.jpg[/img]

You can see the Black Eagle flying around the crash site. It smells the wound from the accident and spawns into the area. It can soar high in the sky or do flybys near the terrain floor, where, if your lucky you can get a nice view of their beautiful wings and animation.

These eagles will be sporadically placed around the level and spawn into an area where the player gets wounded. They will eat on corpses nearby. Currently, we only have them flying in the sky to add additional atmosphere and realism to the environment.

In the next Dev log. We add hunting tools to kill these animals. Please add frigid to your wish list and follow us on Steam or let me know what you think in the comments.
Thank you for watching and see you at the next one.

notes.title: APRIL EASTER DEMO UPGRADE
notes.content:
[h2]HAPPY EASTER AND WELCOME BACK[/h2]
We have updated the demo with plenty of new features and polished bugs and addressed fan feedback. This upgrade preps the system for the Pristine Resort Update which is coming this month.

We hope you enjoy the new upgrade. Please head over to the steam discussion forum and let us know what you think.

[h2][u]MAJOR UPDATE FEATURES[/u][/h2]

[h3]INTRO CINEMATIC[/h3]
The first big feature you will notice is a brand new story cinematic which teases the story along with amazing music composed by [url=https://tylerclinework.wixsite.com/music]TYLER CLINE[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/d629ce03544703c331d72aaf529ee162ca78e591.jpg[/img]

[h3]NEW FIRST PERSON 3D CHARACTER[/h3] gives a more realistic presence for the player.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/39f2f88af3836293f60c915ab865776a6dd988f8.jpg[/img]

[h3]OBJECTIVES SYSTEM[/h3]
We added an objectives system and menu to keep track of and review your objectives in-game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/b8f4b57a30615a037b58142dcb9f1e979a1f66d5.jpg[/img]

[h3]NOTES SYSTEM[/h3]
We have added a new notes system along with notes in the game to further tell the background story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/d5a6b9e52e17923eac80ae0410bf10a1beb585a6.jpg[/img]

[h3]MENU SETTINGS[/h3]
We have a working Settings Menu for Graphics, Sound, Mouse options along with plenty of options and basic keybindings. [Let us know if you need something.]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/d966aa72928f7c875a93bc35d5be5a1b39d174ba.jpg[/img]

[h3]NEW ENVIRONMENT RESOURCES[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/88feac0bc23721af227f0b2fc0cd7cd056ce20a3.jpg[/img]

NEW ITEM RESOURCES
Pillows, curtains, and blankets have been added for resource collection.
Frozen Water Bottles Added. They need to been heated up before consumption.
Including a few Breakable Objects.

FOILAGE RESOURCES
You can now find bare bushes, berry plants, and broken-down tree trunks for collecting resources.

[h3]NEW LAUNCH SCREEN AND LOADING SCREEN REVAMP[/h3]

[h3]TESSELATED SNOW AREAS[/h3]
Dead Ends now have tesselated snow to represent deep loose wet snow blocking mobility.



[h2][u]MINOR UPDATE FEATURES[/u][/h2]

GAME HINT MODE
This option offers newer players frost waypoints to guide the player in the proper direction.
Not recommended for survival fans. [This needs to be turned on]

NEW BASIC DOORS
[NON PHYSICAL INTERACTION] + DOOR ICONS. SHELVES AND DRAWERS ADDED [NO ICONS]
The new doors are much simpler to use. This was based on your feedback. thank you

CAMPFIRES REVAMPED
Fires now gradually warm you up when on and when turned off lose all heat.
Fires now consistently ignite and extinguish the flame FX.
The original campfires required you to examine what was missing from the fires in order to start it. Most users avoided the tutorial and found this to be a bug. So we simplified the Fires to simply use any source of flammable fuel.

CONSUMABLE INTERACTIVE FEATURE [ANIMATE CONSUMABLES]
1-Click Consumable Drinks, Bandage, and Canned Food.
Removed the need to hold down the left mouse button until the food consume animation is complete in order to consume items. 

SURVIVAL METERS
Health, Stamina, Temperature, Food, and Hunger Meters reductions have been tweaked for a more enjoyable experience. Temperature reduction is not affected by walking and sprinting anymore.

INFORMATION NOTICES REVAMPED
The information Indicators now have shadows and outlines to contrast against the background for better reading visibility. It is much easier to read tasks and important information.

FROST HUD NOW ADJUSTS TO TEMPERATURE DEGREES

NEW SLEEPING BAG
This replaces the Tent found in the original demo, and it puts you to sleep to end the demo. 
[The Sleeping system will come in Resort Update along with the TOD]



[h2][u]PATCH AND BUG UPDATES INCLUDE[/u][/h2]

Fire Converter U.I Revamped for a more clear and logical layout. Text shadows added.

Footstep SDFX volume increased.

Pain SDFX CUE added for variation

Mobility weapon adjustments [AXE] movement speeds have been adjusted

Tutorials text updated to be more condensed and more concise for easier reading.

Breathing SDFX quieter and less visible FXS

HeadBob FX added during Sprinting

Environment Blockades modified and polished

Landscape Terrain Decals sporadically added for visuals improvement

Cleaned up U.I missing Ice elements + campfire fuel interaction problems

Additional Level Objectives added

Correct Drop item Mesh pickups

Added more sporadic landscape grass to ground rock walls into the environment

Corpse Collisions Fixed

Environment Wind SDFX volume 50% decreased

SnowMan clothing removed [will reintroduce once setup properly]

Bleeding removed [Will add later when more obvious]


We need your help, if you have played the demo and enjoyed the game or not, please fill out our Questionnaire with the link provided.  This will help us a lot with the decision going forward in Frigid.
[url=https://forms.gle/R7A1ymQ2oiEShT5n6][/url]

notes.title: The Pristine Resort Update is Coming!
notes.content:

We have been updating the demo with an extended play-through to reveal more gameplay and features including some background story, so you can experience a deeper Frigid environment.

In the extended demo, you will wake up the next day, and move deeper into town looking for any help as events unfold to reveal clues about what has happened to this once beautiful lake resort.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/b87c700466ea5fd00e85d8bab408ff72b55dfde6.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]TIME OF DAY LIGHTING[/b][/h3]
If you move fast or take things slow, you will experience different lighting in the environment. 
This will add an additional visual enhancement to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/63ff177cb096cbbec4451d8ef87be1dbd35364be.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]SNOW FOOTSTEPS TESSELLATION[/b][/h3]
To give frigid a more realistic feeling we have added a well-known visual graphics footstep displacement feature.

[h3][b]NEW FLARE GUN TOOL REVEAL[/b][/h3]
We have added a new tool, the flare gun, this will come in handy against wild animals and help light up dark areas at night.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/a00e182659121388a1ca5f7ad6de91e4122c8a13.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]PRISTINE LAKE STORY BACKGROUND[/b][/h3]
We reveal a piece of the story and many clues behind the events unfolding in the pristine lake area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/da03cea800765978cd6208c9d5ef9869802d1189.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/746764ba51e9618c41c6147b3f243647b2bcc962.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]WOLVES COULD BE PRESENT![/b][/h3]
If we can fine-tune some AI Bugs, we will have added some hungry wolves into the mix. Specifically to illustrate how to avoid them. This is important! Since a pack of wolves will kill you quickly.

[h3][b]PLENTY OF UPDATED FEATURES AND BUGS[/b][/h3]
We have been polishing the game and adding new features. A full list will come in the demo update release. So jump back in again and surprise yourself and see what has changed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/afbc7d4a19643483ddebbed73ff26c67026c8100.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]YOUR FEEDBACK![/b][/h3]  
We would love to hear your feedback, If you have played the demo and enjoyed the game or not, Please fill out our Questionnaire with the link provided or leave a comment in the DISCORD.  
This will help us a lot with the decision going forward in Frigid.
[url=https://forms.gle/R7A1ymQ2oiEShT5n6]FRIGID SURVEY[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/mM4WpDr]FRIGID DISCORD[/url]

[h1][b]DEV STREAM COMING THIS WEEKEND![/b][/h1] 
JOIN US! BE A PART OF THIS EXPERIENCE AND SHARE YOUR IDEAS, BE CURIOUS ASK QUESTIONS, HELP US MAKE THE MOST ATMOSPHERIC WINTER GAME OUT THERE!
Look forward to hearing from all of you this weekend. Thank you and see you soon.
